ruleDefinitions.name: Renamed Powershell Under Powershell Channel
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects a renamed Powershell execution, which is a common technique used to circumvent security controls and bypass detection logic that's dependent on process names and process paths.
 Note: Unmapped fields: Data

sequences.query: Data = RGX(".*HostName\\=ConsoleHost.*") AND  NOT ((Data = RGX(".*HostApplication\\=powershell.*") OR Data = RGX(".*HostApplication\\=C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1\\\.0\\\\powershell.*") OR Data = RGX(".*HostApplication\\=C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1\\\.0\\\\powershell.*") OR Data = RGX(".*HostApplication\\=C\\:\\/Windows\\/System32\\/WindowsPowerShell\\/v1\\\.0\\/powershell.*") OR Data = RGX(".*HostApplication\\=C\\:\\/Windows\\/SysWOW64\\/WindowsPowerShell\\/v1\\\.0\\/powershell.*") OR Data = RGX(".*HostApplication\\=C\\:\\\\\\\\WINDOWS\\\\\\\\system32\\\\\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\\\\\v1\\\.0\\\\\\\\powershell\\\.exe.*") OR Data = RGX(".*HostApplication\\=C\\:\\\\\\\\WINDOWS\\\\\\\\SysWOW64\\\\\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\\\\\v1\\\.0\\\\\\\\powershell\\\.exe.*")) OR Data = RGX("HostId=[a-zA-Z0-9-]{36}\s+EngineVersion="))
